w:r.w:t: 复杂布局压力测试
本文档覆盖多级标题、缩进、对齐、行距规则、混排与分页边界。
一、对齐方式

【左对齐】The layout engine must decide where each line breaks, how tall each line is, and when to start a new page. These three decisions interact: a taller line consumes more vertical space, which can push the remaining content onto the following page, which in turn changes nothing about the line breaking itself.
